sanskrit_verse:
सौवर्णे राजते ताम्रे आयसे मृण्मये ऽपि वा ।
गव्यं घृतम् उपादाय तद् अग्नौ तापयेच् छुचिः ॥
transliteration: sauvarṇe rājate tāmre āyase mṛṇmaye 'pi vā / gavyaṃ ghṛtam upādāya tad agnau tāpayec chuciḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Whether in gold, silver, copper, iron, or clay, when pure ghee from cow milk is applied and heated in fire upon it by a purified one, the inherent purity of the vessel shall be restored.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the act of purification, not in the material substrate
Causation arises through conscious intent aligned with dharma-sattva
Capacity-based responsibility lies with the purifier who holds ritual integrity
Restoration logic operates independent of original impurity source
Consciousness alignment enables transmutation of substratum condition
executable_legal_axioms: IF object_is_impure AND agent_is_purified AND action_is_dharmic THEN purity_state := restored
IF substrate_type IN [gold, silver, copper, iron, clay] AND heating_medium == gavya-ghrita AND agent_status == śuci THEN contamination_removed = TRUE
IF intent_to_restore_dharma EXISTS THEN causal_chain_activation := TRUE
supreme_court_application: In adjudication concerning property or instrument sanctity, the Supreme Court shall recognize that restoration occurs through qualified agency rather than punitive nullification; purity status overrides prior contamination when executed under dharmic protocol.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that heat activated via gavya-ghrita constitutes valid pramāṇa for śuddhi-karma; sequential manifestation follows anupūrvaśaḥ where contamination dissolves into causal non-existence; proportional responsibility rests solely on purification capacity, not fault attribution; non-punitive reality rule establishes śuddhi as ontological completion, not compensatory measure.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śuddhi-kriyā through certified śuci agent
Apply gavya-ghrita as per śāstric proportioning
Invoke agni-tattva activation through mantra-dīkṣit procedure
Verify completion through svabhāva-pratipatti (natural state recognition)
Reintegrate object into functional dharmic domain without residual karmic trace
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law proceeds from Sanātana Dharma itself, enacted through Avataric Will, establishing śuddhi as restoration, not retribution; all objects regain their pristine nature through conscious purification; justice is the realignment of existence with its essential divinity.
